subject.title: Base de datos dev ligera con sandboxes desechables

question: What is the approved first slice and safety boundary for creating `Hamelyn_DEV_BASE` and disposable sandboxes from production-shaped data?
rationale: The issue involves anonymized production-derived data, destructive database commands, index parity, and developer workflow policy, so automation should not choose the permanent data-refresh and safety model alone.

options.title: Approve the narrow tooling slice
options.body: Build only manifest-only audit, index comparison, guarded sandbox create/drop, and docs while leaving refresh/anonymization automation for a later decision.

options.title: Design the full DEV_BASE refresh first
options.body: Pause implementation until maintainers define source cohorts, anonymization rules, ownership, and refresh cadence for `Hamelyn_DEV_BASE`.

options.title: Keep using ad hoc sandboxes
options.body: Do not add shared dev-db tooling yet and continue reusing local scripts such as the fulfillment sandbox for specific flows.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow tooling slice
recommendation.body: Build only manifest-only audit, index comparison, guarded sandbox create/drop, and docs while leaving refresh/anonymization automation for a later decision.

likelyOwner.reason: Javier introduced the nearest existing sandbox/audit files and authored the issue's detailed delivery proposal.
